tests.name: matrix_and_stationary_consistency
tests.details: Recomputed from saved counts and transition matrix.

tests.name: row_stochasticity
tests.details: Rows normalized from within-trajectory sliding lag counts; no cross-trajectory transitions.

tests.name: irreducibility
tests.details: All retained states mutually reachable; no silent component deletion.

tests.name: slowest_ITS_spread
tests.details: Heuristic: slowest decay-time spread <30% across at least three lags. Modes may exchange; inspect spectra, not only this flag.

uncertainties: CK and ITS are finite-data diagnostics; passing cannot prove Markovianity.
No reversible constraint, Bayesian posterior, PCCA+ or classical TPT is implemented.
Stationary populations describe this classical model, not photochemical branching ratios.
